name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of its member Grzegorz Braun. Polish prosecutors asked for this because they want to charge him with several offences from 2022 and 2023, including insulting officials, damaging property, and spraying a fire extinguisher at a person and a menorah. Parliament found no sign that the case is meant to harm his political work. Lifting immunity lets the Polish case go ahead.

- **What changes:** Braun loses his protection from prosecution in Poland, so the criminal case can proceed.
- **Who it affects:** Grzegorz Braun, a Member of the European Parliament elected in June 2024.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to Polish authorities and to Braun.
